meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找回之前的对话和项目背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要查阅过去的会话记录来继续工作。
copy.tagline_en: Search past memories to retrieve prior conversations and project context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look back at previous chat records to continue your work.

howto.what: 装上后,当用户问起过往会话里的内容,Claude 会搜索 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库,先返回带编号的索引列表,再查看相关时间段,最后只取出筛选后的完整记录,而不是一次性拉取全部。
howto.when: 当用户询问之前会话(而非当前对话)的内容时触发,例如“我们上次怎么解决 X”“上周发生了什么”,或直接说“search memory”“mem search”等。

say.text: 我们上次是怎么修复登录报错的?
say.note: 它会先搜索记忆库,返回相关记录索引。

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 里关于认证的笔记
say.note: 按关键词检索并列出匹配的会话记录。

say.text: 上周关于数据库迁移的进展有哪些?
say.note: 按日期范围过滤,显示上周的观察记录。

howto.what_en: When asked about past sessions, Claude searches the claude-mem memory DB: first returns an ID-indexed list, then timeline context, then fetches full records only for filtered IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about PREVIOUS sessions (not current chat), e.g. 'how did we solve X last time?', 'what happened last week?', or says 'search memory', 'mem search', etc.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login error last time?
say_en.note: Searches memory and returns matching record index.

say_en.text: Search claude-mem for notes about authentication.
say_en.note: Keyword search lists matching session records.

say_en.text: What happened last week regarding the DB migration?
say_en.note: Filters by date range and shows observations.
